records.question: For a retrospective report, provide weekday-only weekly forecast MAE, MSE, MAPE and denominators.
records.sql: WITH week_start AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', date('now')) AS start_date), week_end AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', date('now')) AS end_date), weeks AS (SELECT date('now') AS week_start, date('now', '+1 week') AS week_end FROM week_start CROSS JOIN week_end WHERE date('now') >= week_start AND date('now') < week_end), filtered_data AS (SELECT load_hourly.timestamp_utc, load_hourly.region, load_hourly.load_mw, load_hourly.forecast_mw FROM load_hourly WHERE load_hourly.region = 'PJM' AND load_hourly.timestamp_utc >= '2024-11-01T00:00:00Z' AND load_hourly.timestamp_utc < '2024-11-15T00:00:00Z' AND strftime('%W', load_hourly.timestamp_utc) = strftime('%W', '2024-11-01T00:00:00Z') AND strftime('%A', load_hourly.timestamp_utc) IN ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday')), weekly_data AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', date('now')) AS week_start, strftime('%Y-%m-%d', date('now', '+1 week')) AS week_end, COUNT(*) AS observed_hours, SUM(load_mw) AS observed_energy, COUNT(forecast_mw) AS forecast_hours, SUM(ABS(load_mw - forecast_mw)) AS mae_mw, SUM(ABS(load_mw - forecast_mw)^2) AS mse_mw2, SUM(ABS((load_mw - forecast_mw)/load_mw)*100) AS mape_pct, SUM(ABS(load_mw - forecast_mw)/load_mw) AS mape_hours FROM filtered_data WHERE load_mw != 0 AND forecast_mw IS NOT NULL GROUP BY week_start), final_weeks AS (SELECT * FROM weeks WHERE week_start >= '2024-11-01T00:00:00Z' AND week_end < '2024-11-15T00:00:00Z') SELECT final_weeks.week_start AS week, weekly_data.observed_hours, weekly_data.forecast_hours, weekly_data.mape_hours, weekly_data.mae_mw, weekly_data.mse_mw2, weekly_data.mape_pct FROM final_weeks INNER JOIN weekly_data ON final_weeks.week_start = weekly_data.week_start ORDER BY week ASC;

records.sql:
SELECT
  DATE('2024-12-02T00:00:00Z', 'start of week', 'weekday') AS week,
  COUNT(*) AS observed_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', timestamp_utc) IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS forecast_hours,
  AVG(ABS((load_mw - forecast_mw) / load_mw)) * 100 AS mape_hours,
  AVG(ABS(load_mw - forecast_mw)) AS mae_mw,
  AVG((load_mw - forecast_mw) * (load_mw - forecast_mw)) AS mse_mw2,
  AVG(ABS((load_mw - forecast_mw) / load_mw)) AS mape_pct
FROM
  load_hourly
WHERE
  timestamp_utc >= '2024-12-02T00:00:00Z' AND
  timestamp_utc < '2024-12-16T00:00:00Z' AND
  strftime('%w', timestamp_utc) IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
GROUP BY
  DATE('2024-12-02T00:00:00Z', 'start of week', 'weekday')
ORDER BY
  week ASC;

records.question: For a retrospective report, provide weekend-only overall forecast MAE, MSE, MAPE and denominators.
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS observed_hours, COUNT(forecast_mw) AS forecast_hours, COUNT(CASE WHEN forecast_mw IS NOT NULL AND load_mw > 0 THEN 1 END) AS mape_hours,
            ROUND(AVG(ABS(forecast_mw - load_mw)), 3) AS mae_mw,
            ROUND(AVG((forecast_mw - load_mw) * (forecast_mw - load_mw)), 3) AS mse_mw2,
            ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN load_mw > 0 AND forecast_mw IS NOT NULL
                THEN 100.0 * ABS(forecast_mw - load_mw) / load_mw END), 3) AS mape_pct FROM load_hourly WHERE 1=1 AND CAST(STRFTIME('%w', timestamp_utc) AS INTEGER) IN (0, 6)
